setup: A product of two trigonometric factors equals zero, and the equation is solved on an interval of [[N]] full turns.

steps.say: A product is zero exactly when at least one of its factors is zero, so each factor is solved on its own.
Each factor repeats with a period that divides one turn of 360 degrees, so the angles it produces come back in every one of the [[N]] turns.
The total counts the distinct angles from both factors across the interval, so an angle that both factors share is counted once.
